body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Sony displayed its Cyber-shot digital camera 'DSC-TX7' at CES 2010, which adopts a 3.5-inch touch screen and a 10M Exmor R CMOS sensor with a 4x zoom lens.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
